module.title: Server: Log: Request
module.description:
Log for requests on web applications.
Automatically logs all HTTP requests and CLI job calls.
There are 2 ways to store the collected request data on each app request: - directly into database - append to log file
To avoid database write commands on heavy load apps, storing the data in a file at first is possible. Logged entries can be imported by job periodically. This is recommended at the moment. File locks are missing and so on.
module.log: Support log file to avoid database work on each request.
module.author: Christian Würker
